question: is the live agent still what was shipped, judged against the frozen baseline's noise band and every series, not the best launch number?

planted.what: The baseline's own five runs spread 84%-90%. The live samples (85-88%) are inside that band, so the pass rate alone shows no drift. 90% was the best baseline run, not the baseline.

The refusal rate climbed from about 2% to 6% and then 9%, past the release note's 5% paging threshold. Legitimate return and billing tickets are being refused. This is the live problem, and it shows in its own series while the pass rate holds.

The logs show the model changed from claude-sonnet-5-5-20260801 to claude-sonnet-5-5-20260915 in the week of 2026-09-21, the same week refusals started rising. config/agent.yaml was 'simplified' on 2026-09-16 to an unpinned alias. The lost pin is the root cause, and the prompt is unchanged.

traps.what: Calling the pass-rate move from 90% to 85-86% a regression or drift. It is inside the baseline spread, and 90% was one run, not the baseline.
